2610.13600.title: AudioTETRIS: Token Elimination via Transitional Importance Signals for Efficient Audio LLMs
2610.13600.paper_summary: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) achieve strong performance on speech-text tasks, but standard audio encoders produce hundreds of tokens for even short audio clips. Because self-attention scales quadratically in sequence length, this inflates inference-time compute substantially. Current training-free token compression methods prune or merge tokens based solely on coarse attention or feature similarity. However, treating audio tokens as generic, isotropic features smooths over spectral transitions, destroying fine-grained phonetic transitions essential for decoding speech. In contrast, speech signals exhibit highly structured temporal patterns where information density peaks at acoustic transitions. We propose AudioTETRIS, a training-free, two-stage framework that uses the audio encoder's representation geometry as an acoustic prior for token importance before applying attention-based compression. Instead of discarding encoder structure after the encoding stage, AudioTETRIS propagates this prior directly into the LLM decoder to compute a per-token fused score. This score drives progressive top-$k$ token selection across decoder layers without requiring additional training or auxiliary models. Evaluated on Qwen2-Audio-7B, Phi-4-Multimodal, and Audio Flamingo 3, AudioTETRIS retains near-uncompressed performance on several speech tasks using only 25% of audio tokens, matches or surpasses full-token accuracy at moderate compression rates, and consistently outperforms existing training-free baselines.
2610.13600.paper_summary_zh: 大型音頻語言模型（LALMs）在語音文本任務上表現出色，但標準音頻編碼器對於即使是短音頻片段也會產生數百個標記。由於自注意力在序列長度上以平方級增長，這大幅增加了推理時的計算量。目前的無需訓練的標記壓縮方法僅根據粗略的注意力或特徵相似性來修剪或合併標記。然而，將音頻標記視為通用的各向同性特徵會平滑過頻譜過渡，破壞解碼語音所必需的細粒度音位過渡。相反，語音信號顯示出高度結構化的時間模式，其中信息密度在聲學過渡處達到峰值。我們提出了AudioTETRIS，一種無需訓練的兩階段框架，利用音頻編碼器的表示幾何作為標記重要性的聲學先驗，然後應用基於注意力的壓縮。在編碼階段之後，AudioTETRIS並不丟棄編碼器結構，而是將這一先驗直接傳遞到LLM解碼器中，以計算每個標記的融合分數。這一分數驅動解碼器層之間的逐步前$k$標記選擇，而不需要額外的訓練或輔助模型。在Qwen2-Audio-7B、Phi-4-Multimodal和Audio Flamingo 3上的評估顯示，AudioTETRIS在多個語音任務上僅使用25%的音頻標記即可保持接近無壓縮的性能，在中等壓縮率下匹配或超越全標記的準確性，並且始終優於現有的無需訓練的基準。
